failure_modes: A temporal_teacher_blend or temporal_region edit could displace surrounding landmark and local coordinates in opposing directions across the observed window, since the contrast is non-monotone with 4-10 sign changes and no accepted polynomial.
Dose edits (pointcloud_delta_A) would change force magnitude without any supplied absolute affinity target, so no expected affinity advantage can be verified.
Endpoint coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation, so any claimed affinity gain from these edits would be unsupported.
No decoded terminal labels or current-study outcome data are supplied, so last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
result.rationale: D1.2: The registered temporal alternatives (C008 temporal_region_index, C009-C011 temporal_teacher_blend) change only regional attention at observed score nodes or blend the observed-node teacher contrast; they do not alter the static teacher coordinates, the shared learned support, or the dose. The Analyst's temporal evidence (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb) shows non-monotone landmark_00_soft_mass and local derivative features with large opposing first/last rate z-scores, 4-10 sign changes, no accepted polynomial and extrapolation disallowed. That supports a time-conditioned contrast only as observed-node interpolation, and the rate z-scores are temporal derivatives, not spatial coordinate gradients, so they cannot justify a stationary coordinate target or a velocity force. D4.1: The incumbent already uses teacher_neighbors=4, pointcloud_delta_A=1.0 and no temporal blend; the offered edits are either dose changes (C001-C003 pointcloud_delta_A) or attention/teacher changes (C004-C011). The endpoint evidence (Ecbb36ef90768cba0, E3114d60bf4cd5720) is a signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrast, not an absolute affinity target, and the clocks observation (E0857891f4effbfe1) confirms recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior, so no absolute affinity benefit can be claimed for any offered edit. With affinity primary and no defensible expected advantage over the incumbent, retaining is the evidence-supported choice. D4.2: The predicted failure of a temporal-blend edit is unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates: the non-monotone sign-flipping contrast would move landmark and local coordinates in opposing directions across the window, and the weak axis-specific centroid evidence (E52fcd92a3390dbcf) would not constrain that drift. Because coordinate graph changes alone are not a failure mechanism and no affinity benefit is demonstrated, this prediction reinforces retaining the incumbent rather than editing.
